notes: Sourced from Focusrite's official RedNet MP8R datasheet (MP8R-DS v1.0, fael-downloads-prod.focusrite.com), which is the authoritative manufacturer spec sheet. Rear panel: 8x XLR3F mic/line inputs, 2x locking etherCON Dante network ports (Primary/Secondary, also accept standard RJ45 plugs), 2x IEC AC inlets with retaining clips (100-240Vac 50/60Hz, dual redundant PSU A/B). No word clock, GPIO, or other digital I/O ports are present on this unit - all audio I/O is via the Dante network. The datasheet does not state an Ethernet link-speed rating for the Dante ports, so no bandwidth grade was assigned (Dante devices of this era commonly run 100Mbps-capable links, but this is not confirmed in the source). The unit outputs audio only via the Dante network (no analogue outputs) - it appears on the network as a 16-channel Dante transmitter (8 direct preamp feeds + 8 gain-compensated feeds), not as a physical port.
